summary: Initializes suspension geometry for a single wheel slot: computes the wheel offset vector from the chassis local origin, copies the suspension orientation matrix and the upright orientation matrix into per-wheel geometry storage, and extracts Euler angles from both matrices with gimbal-lock handling.

operations.description: Compute wheel offset vector by subtracting the chassis local origin (this+0x48/0x4C/0x50 = X/Y/Z) from the input position a3, and store the three components into the wheel offset vector (v8[0..2]).
Mirror the same three offset components into the geometry block at v5+184/+188/+192.
Copy the suspension orientation matrix (0x24 bytes, 3x3 floats) from a4 into per-wheel geometry storage at v6.
Load an element of the copied suspension orientation matrix (this[74*a2+93]), pass it through FloatConvertWrapper, negate it, and store the result at v5+128.
Gimbal-lock check on the suspension matrix: if fabs of a matrix element equals 1.0 (the constant 1.0 at 0x0059E420), take the alternate atan2 branch and force the second angle to 0.
Extract the first Euler angle from the suspension matrix via atan2(v6[2], v6[8]) when not in gimbal lock.
Extract the second Euler angle from the suspension matrix via atan2(v6[3], v6[4]) when not in gimbal lock.
Copy the upright orientation matrix (0x24 bytes, 3x3 floats) from a5 into the geometry block at v5+208.
Load an element of the copied upright matrix (v5+228), pass it through FloatConvertWrapper, negate it, and store at v5+196.
Second gimbal-lock check: if fabs of the upright matrix element (v5+228) equals 1.0, use the alternate atan2 formula and force the second angle to 0.
Extract the first Euler angle from the upright matrix via atan2(v5+216, v5+240) when not in gimbal lock.
Extract the second Euler angle from the upright matrix via atan2(v5+220, v5+224) when not in gimbal lock.
